pick.name: Ollama
pick.what: Local model server with Windows installer, OpenAI-compatible API, model library
pick.why: Zero-config installers on macOS, Windows and Linux, OpenAI-compatible API, providers in AI SDK/Pydantic AI, MIT
pick.install: macOS/Linux: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh ; Windows: irm https://ollama.com/install.ps1 | iex

alts.name: llama.cpp (llama-server)
alts.what: Reference C/C++ engine: AVX2/AVX512, ZenDNN for AMD CPU, OpenAI-compatible server
alts.why: Maximum control and newest model support first
alts.install: macOS/Linux: curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh ; Windows: irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex

alts.name: MLX LM (Apple)
alts.what: Python package to run and fine-tune LLMs on Apple silicon with MLX
alts.why: Fastest/most native path on Mac unified memory, includes LoRA fine-tuning

candidates.name: Ollama
candidates.verdict: Pick: easiest install, MIT, all three OSes

candidates.name: MLX LM
candidates.verdict: Apple silicon only; fastest on Mac

candidates.name: LM Studio
candidates.verdict: Good GUI; licence/commercial terms not verified

candidates.name: vLLM
candidates.verdict: Production GPU serving (NVIDIA/AMD); not for laptops

decision: Ollama is the default runner for development and sidecar use on any OS; drop to llama.cpp for bleeding-edge models and tuning, MLX LM on Apple silicon for speed, vLLM for multi-user GPU serving. Local models trade quality for privacy and zero marginal cost.
details: GPU support per docs.ollama.com/gpu: NVIDIA compute capability 5.0+ (driver 550+), AMD Radeon via ROCm v7 (Linux broad; Windows select RX 7000/PRO W7000), Apple Metal, and Vulkan on Windows/Linux.

os_notes.macOS: Apple silicon uses unified memory: 16GB runs 4-8B Q4 comfortably, 32GB+ runs 20-30B MoE; MLX LM is the fastest path.
os_notes.Windows: Native installer; NVIDIA GPUs (driver 550+) and select AMD RX 7000/PRO W7000 GPUs used automatically, Vulkan covers other GPUs, otherwise CPU. WSL not needed.
os_notes.Linux: NVIDIA (CUDA, compute capability 5.0+), AMD Radeon/Instinct via ROCm v7, or Vulkan; vLLM for multi-user server throughput.

verify.note: Checked against primary sources; wording made neutral during verification.
